set.body:
Small, independent, all verified:

1. R/sandwich_variance_doc.R:47 calls fmri_lm(model, dataset, config = cfg).
   `config` is not an accepted name and this errors ("Unexpected arguments:
   config"). It survives only because it sits inside \dontrun{} (lines 38-51).
   The correct dots name is cfg.

2. README.md line 8 (library(fmrireg)) has no opening code fence; the block is
   closed at line 25.

3. fmri_lm_control(na_action=) has no @param; man/fmri_lm_control.Rd shows it in
   \usage with no \item.

4. ar_options$by_cluster is read at R/aaa_plugin_api.R:210, :234, :241, :277 and by
   both engines, but appears in no default_ar list (R/fmri_lm_config.R:116-124) and
   in no @details.

5. R/fmrilm.R:615-617 documents `energy`/`nboot` as legacy aliases for
   engine_args$energy_keep / bootstrap_n with no runtime deprecation signal.
set.title: Doc hygiene found during the interface audit
